paper.title_en: Proper Time Shifts in Pulsar Timing Arrays
paper.abstract_en: Pulsar timing arrays are a powerful tool for probing low-frequency gravitational phenomena and physics beyond the Standard Model. We establish a general, gauge-invariant framework for the timing residual by identifying the measurable quantity as the proper time interval between consecutive pulse arrivals at Earth. In linearized general relativity, we derive a general expression for this proper time shift and show that it decomposes into Doppler, Shapiro, and Einstein delay contributions whose sum is gauge invariant, similar to frameworks that have been developed for other gravitational-wave detectors such as laser and atom interferometers. We also provide a recipe for computing the resulting timing residual for any specified perturbation, and we illustrate the method with several physically well-motivated sources, recovering known results where they exist in the literature. This recipe can be directly applied to search for new physics from real pulsar timing data using existing numerical software.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文为脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时移建立了规范不变的通用框架，将计时残差分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟，并给出了可直接应用于真实数据的计算配方，理论深度与实用性兼具，与PTA主题高度相关。
decision.title_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列中的固有时移
decision.abstract_zh: 脉冲星计时阵列是探测低频引力现象和超越标准模型物理的有力工具。我们通过将可测量量确定为连续脉冲到达地球之间的固有时时间间隔，建立了一个通用的、规范不变的计时残差框架。在线性化广义相对论中，我们推导了该固有时移的一般表达式，并表明其可分解为多普勒、夏皮罗和爱因斯坦延迟贡献，三者之和是规范不变的，这类似于为激光和原子干涉仪等其他引力波探测器所发展的框架。我们还提供了一种计算任意给定微扰所导致的计时残差的配方，并用几个物理上动机明确的源来说明该方法，在文献中存在已知结果的地方重新得到了这些结果。该配方可直接应用于利用现有数值软件从真实脉冲星计时数据中寻找新物理。
